newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH PACCAR UNIT DAF STEPS UP PRODUCTION.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH PACCAR UNIT DAF STEPS UP PRODUCTION.

text.p: Dutch DAF Trucks NV said on Tuesday it expected to raise its production to about 18,000 vehicles this year, up 1,000 from 1996.
"The order book is such that we are considering increasing the number of employees with fixed contracts, which is now based on daily production of 60 trucks," the company said.

DAF Trucks, a fully-owned unit of U.S. truck maker Paccar since the end of 1996, currently has 4,959 employees, 700 of whom are hired on a temporary basis. The total number of workers is seen rising to about 5,300 by the end of this year, it said.
The company said it had booked its 5,000th order for the DAF95XF heavy truck, which was introduced recently.
Eight weeks after production of the new series started, the 1000th DAF95XF was completed. The vehicle offers fuel savings of five to 10 percent compared with other trucks, DAF said.
